pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. "Maliki yawmid-din" means (1 mark)
   A. Guide us to the path
   B. Lord of all the worlds
   C. Master of the Day of Judgement
   D. The Most Kind

2. "I have been sent for the purpose of perfecting good morals." Who narrated this hadith according to the syllabus? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Lahab
   B. Muslim
   C. Al-Hakim
   D. Ibn Majah

3. What does it mean to "emulate" the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Forget his words
   B. Fear him
   C. Argue with him
   D. Copy his good example

4. In the hadith about eating, from which part of the dish should we eat? (1 mark)
   A. The other person's side
   B. The part directly in front of us
   C. Any side we like
   D. The middle

5. The Kiswahili word for the tooth-cleaning stick or brush is (1 mark)
   A. Mswaki
   B. Kanzu
   C. Mkeka
   D. Kofia

6. What happens when germs feed on sugar left on teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Teeth grow longer
   B. Teeth become stronger
   C. They make acid that causes cavities
   D. Nothing happens

7. Which of these is a value from sports? (1 mark)
   A. Anger
   B. Cheating
   C. Humility in winning
   D. Boasting

8. Why should a Muslim not cheat in a game? (1 mark)
   A. Referees are strict
   B. Cheating is fun
   C. Islam teaches honesty and fairness
   D. Cheating is a Sunnah

9. Which activity is not allowed in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Playing football fairly
   B. Swimming
   C. Betting on a game
   D. Running

10. Which name reminds us that Allah sees us when we are alone? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Malik
   B. Al-Basir
   C. As-Salam
   D. Ar-Rahim

11. Which angel brings revelation to the prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Malakul Maut
   B. Mikail
   C. Jibril
   D. Israfil

12. Which is true about angels? (1 mark)
   A. They are jinn
   B. They are humans
   C. They are gods
   D. They are honoured servants of Allah

13. Which prophet helped his father to build the Kaaba? (1 mark)
   A. Ismail
   B. Idris
   C. Yunus
   D. Hud

14. What is patience? (1 mark)
   A. Staying calm and trusting Allah in hardship
   B. Getting angry
   C. Giving up
   D. Complaining

15. Which verse says Allah sends down pure water from the sky? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 110:1
   B. Qur'an 112:1
   C. Qur'an 25:48
   D. Qur'an 1:1

16. Which of these breaks wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Talking
   B. Eating
   C. Passing wind
   D. Sweating

17. Which subject helps you find directions with a compass? (1 mark)
   A. Cookery only
   B. Music
   C. Social Studies
   D. Art

18. Which prayer is prayed at dawn? (1 mark)
   A. Fajr
   B. Isha
   C. Asr
   D. Dhuhr

19. What do we say when rising from ruku? (1 mark)
   A. Amin
   B. Bismillah
   C. Alhamdulillah alone
   D. Sami'allahu liman hamidah

20. How are the postures of swalah good for health? (1 mark)
   A. They harm the knees
   B. They cause sickness
   C. They stretch and move the body
   D. They stop movement

21. Which of these is a Sunnah act, not a pillar? (1 mark)
   A. Fatiha
   B. Sujud
   C. Ruku
   D. Raising hands with the first takbir

22. What is takbiratul ihram? (1 mark)
   A. Bowing
   B. Saying "Allahu Akbar" to begin the prayer
   C. Reciting Fatiha
   D. Saying salaam

23. Which is a safe practice around stray dogs? (1 mark)
   A. Do not go near them and tell an adult
   B. Chase them
   C. Feed them by hand
   D. Tease them

24. Which of these is broadcast media? (1 mark)
   A. Radio
   B. Book
   C. Magazine
   D. Poster

25. How can too much screen time affect a child? (1 mark)
   A. Improves health
   B. Helps prayer
   C. Wastes time and harms eyes and sleep
   D. Makes them taller

26. Which of these is a skill that can bring honest income later? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Stealing
   C. Tailoring
   D. Lying

27. Who does the dua protect from harm? (1 mark)
   A. Only adults
   B. Only animals
   C. The one who says it, by Allah's will
   D. Nobody

28. What does Qur'an 66:6 tell believers? (1 mark)
   A. Sell everything
   B. Travel far
   C. Protect yourselves and your families
   D. Ignore your family

29. How can children show thanks to parents? (1 mark)
   A. Compare them with others
   B. Complain
   C. Ignore them
   D. Say thank you and make dua for them

30. Which is a good reply to a parent's call? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting
   B. "Leave me alone."
   C. Silence
   D. "Yes, Mama, I am coming."

31. Which is a way to help parents at home? (1 mark)
   A. Hide
   B. Complain
   C. Break things
   D. Sweep and wash dishes

32. Which is a bad habit toward relatives? (1 mark)
   A. Gossiping about them
   B. Helping them
   C. Visiting them
   D. Greeting them

33. What did the Prophet say about the one who cuts family ties? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. He is honoured
   C. He is rewarded
   D. He will not enter Paradise

34. What was he called before prophethood? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Haqq
   B. As-Siddiq
   C. Al-Amin
   D. Al-Farooq

35. What does the command "Iqra" teach us? (1 mark)
   A. Stay silent
   B. Avoid books
   C. Only pray
   D. Seek knowledge

36. Whose bed did Ali sleep in on the night of the Prophet's migration? (1 mark)
   A. Khadija's
   B. Bilal's
   C. The Prophet's
   D. Abu Bakr's

37. How can we honour the early converts? (1 mark)
   A. Forget them
   B. Ignore them
   C. Insult them
   D. Learn their stories and copy their qualities

38. Who was the Prophet's close friend who believed at once? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Bakr
   B. Abu Jahl
   C. Waraqa
   D. Abu Lahab

39. What can we learn from Ali about young people? (1 mark)
   A. Only adults matter
   B. Even young people can accept truth and be brave
   C. Children are weak
   D. Children cannot help

40. What do we learn from the Taif journey? (1 mark)
   A. Be patient and merciful when hurt
   B. Give up
   C. Take revenge
   D. Insult others

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain why Muslims should not waste food and give two ways of avoiding waste. (4 marks)

42. Explain how a Grade 4 child can apply the command "Iqra". (4 marks)

43. Explain the lesson from the story of the man who gave a dog water. (3 marks)

44. Describe three Islamic manners to observe during games. (3 marks)

45. Write the meaning of the dua for leaving the house. (3 marks)

46. Give three character traits of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and one way to practise each. (3 marks)

47. How did Khadija (R.A.) comfort the Prophet (S.A.W.)? (3 marks)

48. Explain how the greeting "As-salamu alaykum" is connected to a name of Allah. (3 marks)

49. How should a Muslim treat a person who asks for help? (4 marks)

50. Describe how Ali (R.A.) accepted Islam and what he did as a young man. (3 marks)

51. Describe how each of the six names studied should change our behaviour. (5 marks)

52. What happened to the woman who did not feed her cat? (3 marks)

53. Describe how to find the Qibla using the sun in Kenya. (3 marks)

54. Explain what a Muslim child should do before sharing a message. (4 marks)

55. Role-play plan: Write a short scene showing a parent fulfilling one obligation and the child's thanks. (5 marks)

56. Explain how Prophet Ayyub (A.S.) showed patience. (3 marks)

57. Describe what you should do when you enter your home. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Master of the Day of Judgement
   It is the fourth verse of Al-Fatiha.

2. C — Al-Hakim
   The syllabus gives Al-Hakim as the narrator.

3. D — Copy his good example
   To emulate is to follow an example.

4. B — The part directly in front of us
   The hadith says "eat what is directly in front of you".

5. A — Mswaki
   Mswaki means toothbrush or chewing stick.

6. C — They make acid that causes cavities
   Acid damages the teeth.

7. C — Humility in winning
   A Muslim thanks Allah and stays humble.

8. C — Islam teaches honesty and fairness
   Honesty applies in games too.

9. C — Betting on a game
   Gambling is forbidden.

10. B — Al-Basir
   Al-Basir sees everything.

11. C — Jibril
   Jibril brought the Qur'an to the Prophet.

12. D — They are honoured servants of Allah
   Angels are creations of light.

13. A — Ismail
   Ismail and Ibrahim raised the foundations.

14. A — Staying calm and trusting Allah in hardship
   Patience is steady calm.

15. C — Qur'an 25:48
   Surah Al-Furqan 25:48.

16. C — Passing wind
   Anything from the front or back passage breaks wudhu.

17. C — Social Studies
   Social Studies teaches direction finding.

18. A — Fajr
   Fajr is at dawn.

19. D — Sami'allahu liman hamidah
   Allah hears the one who praises Him.

20. C — They stretch and move the body
   Regular movement keeps joints flexible.

21. D — Raising hands with the first takbir
   Sunnah acts add reward.

22. B — Saying "Allahu Akbar" to begin the prayer
   It starts the prayer.

23. A — Do not go near them and tell an adult
   Some animals may bite.

24. A — Radio
   Radio and television broadcast.

25. C — Wastes time and harms eyes and sleep
   Excess is harmful.

26. C — Tailoring
   Tailoring is a skill.

27. C — The one who says it, by Allah's will
   Allah protects.

28. C — Protect yourselves and your families
   Families need guidance.

29. D — Say thank you and make dua for them
   Gratitude.

30. D — "Yes, Mama, I am coming."
   Politeness.

31. D — Sweep and wash dishes
   Helping is a duty.

32. A — Gossiping about them
   Gossip breaks ties.

33. D — He will not enter Paradise
   A warning in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

34. C — Al-Amin
   Al-Amin means the trustworthy.

35. D — Seek knowledge
   Islam values knowledge.

36. C — The Prophet's
   He did so to protect the Prophet.

37. D — Learn their stories and copy their qualities
   Imitate their good deeds.

38. A — Abu Bakr
   Abu Bakr was called As-Siddiq.

39. B — Even young people can accept truth and be brave
   Ali was a boy.

40. A — Be patient and merciful when hurt
   The Prophet's example.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah does not love the wasteful. Take only what you can finish, and share leftovers while fresh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for reason, 1 mark for Qur'an 7:31 or Allah's dislike, 2 marks for two ways.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Read and study daily, ask teachers questions, use safe sources to learn, share knowledge with others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four ways.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: A small act of kindness can earn Allah's forgiveness and reward, and there is reward in serving every living creature.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for kindness, 1 mark for forgiveness, 1 mark for all creatures.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Dress modestly, keep the times of prayer, avoid cheating and insults, respect others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each manner.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might and no power except with Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three parts.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Trustworthy: return borrowed items. Truthful: tell the truth about mistakes. Kind: share your lunch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each trait with a suitable way.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: She covered him with a blanket, reminded him of his good character and said Allah would not disgrace him, and took him to Waraqa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: As-Salam is Allah's name meaning the Source of Peace. The greeting is a prayer for peace and safety.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for As-Salam, 1 mark for meaning of the greeting, 1 mark for the link.

49. (4 marks)
   Answer: With kindness and respect, without driving him away, help if in real need, give quietly, or make a kind reply and dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: He saw the Prophet and Khadija praying, asked, and accepted Islam. He was loyal and brave and slept in the Prophet's bed on the night of the migration.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

51. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ar-Rahman: be merciful to all; Ar-Rahim: forgive others; Al-Malik: use things well; As-Salam: bring peace; As-Sami': make dua and speak well; Al-Basir: be honest in private.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct name with matching behaviour up to 5.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: She tied the cat and did not feed it or let it find food. She was punished because of this. It teaches us that cruelty to animals is a sin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for the punishment, 1 mark for the lesson.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stretch the right arm towards the sunrise, which is east, and face forward, which is roughly north. Confirm with a compass or mosque.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the right arm to east, 1 mark for facing north, 1 mark for checking.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: Check whether it is true and kind, and useful and safe. If not sure, do not share, as Qur'an 49:6 says to verify news.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for true, 1 mark for kind, 1 mark for useful or safe, 1 mark for the verse or verifying.

55. (5 marks)
   Answer: A parent helps with homework and the child says thank you and promises to do well. Award for a clear obligation, a clear action and an expression of thanks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the obligation, 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for thanks, 2 marks for clarity.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: He was tested with illness and loss. He did not complain against Allah, called upon Him, and Allah healed him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the test, 1 mark for not complaining, 1 mark for calling upon Allah.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: Say Bismillah and the dua, greet with salaam, place shoes neatly, wash hands, speak kindly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four actions.
